identificationModule.briefTitle: Regulatory T Cells for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase 1 Safety Run-in Study and Phase 1b Randomized, Double Blinded, Placebo Controlled Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Phase 1 Safety Run-in Study of 6 patients followed by Phase 1b Randomized, Double Blind, Placebo Control Trial of CK0803, neurotropic, allogeneic, umbilical cord blood derived T regulatory (Treg) cells in additional 60 patients with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.

interventions.name: CK0803
interventions.description: CK0803 (cryopreserved, allogeneic, cord blood derived T regulatory cells that express neurotropic homing markers) will be administered intravenously
